newsitem.title: USA: All For a Dollar files Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: All For a Dollar files Chapter 11.

text.p: All For A Dollar Inc said on Tuesday it filed for Chapter 11 protection at the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Eastern District of New York.
The company, formed in 1990, currently operates 111 retail close-out variety stores throughout New England, New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania, it said.
Several problems contributed to the company's Chapter 11 filing, including difficulty in obtaining adequate bank financing to procure new merchandise as well as declining store sales, it said.
All For a Dollar said it expects to receive new and fresh merchandise throughout the holiday season and plans to keep all stores open while a plan of reorganization is developed.
